mapper.select: SELECT id, config_name AS configName, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, protocol, smtp_server AS smtpServer, smtp_port AS smtpPort, ency_type AS encyType, account_auth AS accountAuth, username, password, remark FROM bedrock_email_config WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, protocol, smtp_server AS smtpServer, smtp_port AS smtpPort, ency_type AS encyType, account_auth AS accountAuth, username, password FROM bedrock_email_config
is_deleted = 0
and config_code = #{configCode}
and status = 1
limit 1

SELECT id, config_name AS configName, config_code AS configCode, service_provider AS serviceProvider, smtp_server AS smtpServer, smtp_port AS smtpPort, username, status, remark FROM bedrock_email_config WHERE is_deleted = 0
and config_name like concat('%', #{param.configName}, '%')
and config_code like concat('%', #{param.configCode}, '%')
and service_provider = #{param.serviceProvider}
